correctness.rationale: PASS: Independent Fourier zero-sum quartic enumeration reproduces both resonances 1+1+1=3 and 1+3=2+2 and exact S²K polynomial. Both phase signs can be chosen jointly. For the minimum, the middle-harmonic squared amplitude enters with strictly positive deficiency because m=1.22069<3/2; unique root of 3r³−3r²−3r+1 gives the negative-phase 1:3 two-tone extremizer. For the maximum, AM–GM and a factored cubic difference force |U|=|V|, then unique positive root of 3r³+6r²−3r−4 and aligned phases. Exact deficit expressions and endpoint cases constrain all equality cases; bounded independent coefficient convolution diagnostics agree.
